description: Homelab overview: nodes, disks, K3s, Argo CD and network.

panels.title: Infrastructure health

targets.expr: (count(up{job=~"$job",instance=~"$host"} == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="true"} == 0) or vector(0)) + (count(argocd_app_info{health_status=~"Degraded|Missing"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Failed"}) or vector(0)) + (count(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff"} == 1) or vector(0))

panels.description: Open problems: node_exporter target down, K8s node NotReady, Argo apps Degraded/Missing, failed pods, CrashLoopBackOff containers. 0 = healthy.

panels.title: Nodes

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (node_load1{job=~"$job",instance=~"$host"}) / count by (instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",job=~"$job",instance=~"$host"}) * on(instance) group_left(nodename) node_uname_info

panels.description: One row per node_exporter target (your K3s VMs, plus the Proxmox host if you add it).

panels.title: Deployments with missing replicas
panels.description: Desired minus available replicas for every Deployment. Empty = all good.
